# Row-Bot Docs

Public documentation index for Row-Bot.

- [Row-Bot Documentation](/docs/)
  Route: /docs/. A complete public user guide for installing, configuring, and using Row-Bot end to end.
- [Getting Started](/docs/getting-started/)
  Route: /docs/getting-started/. Install Row-Bot, complete first launch, and learn the first choices that matter.
- [Installation](/docs/getting-started/installation)
  Route: /docs/getting-started/installation. Install Row-Bot from a release package or run it from source with clear next steps.
- [First Launch](/docs/getting-started/first-launch)
  Route: /docs/getting-started/first-launch. Answer "How should Row-Bot think?" to choose your first model, then finish the rest at your own pace in Setup Center.
- [Models And Providers](/docs/configuration/models-and-providers)
  Route: /docs/configuration/models-and-providers. Configure providers, discover models, choose defaults, and pin quick model choices.
- [Row-Bot Interface](/docs/app-shell/navigation)
  Route: /docs/app-shell/navigation. Find your way around Row-Bot: the sidebar, Home, a conversation and its details card, panels, the terminal, the command palette and Settings.
- [Home: Overview](/docs/home/overview)
  Route: /docs/home/overview. Start from Home Overview: ask Row-Bot anything, answer what needs you, see live status, and pick up recent work.
- [Chat](/docs/chat/)
  Route: /docs/chat/. Use Row-Bot conversations: the composer, models, attachments, apps and skills in a chat, tools, approvals in place, the details card, names, and the conversation library.
- [Model Picker](/docs/chat/model-picker)
  Route: /docs/chat/model-picker. Choose a conversation's model from one list across local, subscription, pay-per-use and custom providers, and troubleshoot missing models.
- [Reasoning Controls](/docs/chat/reasoning-controls)
  Route: /docs/chat/reasoning-controls. Choose provider-aware reasoning effort, thinking toggles, and token budgets for the active Row-Bot model.
- [Tools, Approvals, And Terminal](/docs/chat/tools-approvals-and-terminal)
  Route: /docs/chat/tools-approvals-and-terminal. Understand Row-Bot tools and tool steps, approvals that wait until you answer, and the interactive terminal docked under a conversation.
- [Progressive Tools And Skills](/docs/guides/progressive-tools-and-skills)
  Route: /docs/guides/progressive-tools-and-skills. Understand how Row-Bot discovers external tools and task-specific skills without loading every capability into every prompt.
- [Profiles, Goals, And Agents](/docs/profiles-goals-agents/)
  Route: /docs/profiles-goals-agents/. Manage agent profiles in the sidebar's Agents dialog, give a conversation a goal that keeps going until done, and follow the agents it delegates to.
- [Workflows](/docs/guides/workflows)
  Route: /docs/guides/workflows. Create, run, schedule, edit, deliver, and troubleshoot Row-Bot workflows.
- [Designs](/docs/designer/)
  Route: /docs/designer/. Create decks, documents, landing pages, app mockups and storyboards with Row-Bot, and edit, present, share and export them in a conversation's Design panel.
- [Code Folders](/docs/developer/)
  Route: /docs/developer/. Work on a folder or repository from a conversation: bind or clone it, review changes, run checks and use Git in the Developer panel.
- [Knowledge](/docs/knowledge/)
  Route: /docs/knowledge/. Explore, search, review and correct what Row-Bot remembers in Home Knowledge, and configure memory in Settings Memory.
- [Wiki Vault](/docs/knowledge/wiki-vault)
  Route: /docs/knowledge/wiki-vault. Keep a local Markdown vault of Row-Bot's memories, with readable file names, and sync your edits back.
- [Knowledge Provenance And Repair](/docs/knowledge/provenance-repair)
  Route: /docs/knowledge/provenance-repair. Trace where knowledge came from, correct records, repair relations, and rebuild derived outputs safely.
- [Computer Use](/docs/computer-use/)
  Route: /docs/computer-use/. Set up and safely use Row-Bot's opt-in native Windows and macOS application control.
- [Monitor](/docs/monitor/)
  Route: /docs/monitor/. See Row-Bot's latest health checks, fix problems in one click, and read activity, maintenance, history and logs.
- [Home: Insights](/docs/home/insights)
  Route: /docs/home/insights. Review what Row-Bot noticed about its skills, settings and memory, and apply or reject its proposals in Home Insights.
- [Phone And Native Desktop](/docs/mobile-native/)
  Route: /docs/mobile-native/. Use the full Row-Bot owner product from a phone, connect it from Settings Devices & remote access, and understand native-only desktop behaviour.
- [How Row-Bot Works](/docs/concepts/)
  Route: /docs/concepts/. Understand Row-Bot's request, knowledge, agent, workflow, and extension models before configuring them.
- [How A Request Runs](/docs/concepts/request-lifecycle)
  Route: /docs/concepts/request-lifecycle. Follow a Row-Bot request through context assembly, a selected model route, tools, approvals, and local history.
- [How Memory Becomes Knowledge](/docs/concepts/memory-knowledge-and-dream-cycle)
  Route: /docs/concepts/memory-knowledge-and-dream-cycle. Understand thread history, memory, documents, the Knowledge Graph, Wiki Vault, and Dream Cycle as related but distinct layers.
- [How Profiles, Goals, And Agents Work](/docs/concepts/profiles-goals-and-agents)
  Route: /docs/concepts/profiles-goals-and-agents. Understand reusable Agent Profiles, durable goals, parent coordination, and bounded child-agent delegation.
- [How Background Workflows Run](/docs/concepts/background-workflows)
  Route: /docs/concepts/background-workflows. Understand saved workflow definitions, schedules, isolated runs, approvals, retries, and delivery semantics.
- [Extensions And Trust Boundaries](/docs/concepts/extensions-and-trust)
  Route: /docs/concepts/extensions-and-trust. Compare Row-Bot tools, Skills, Custom Tools, plugins, MCP servers, channels, and accounts by what they add and where they run.
- [Settings](/docs/settings/)
  Route: /docs/settings/. Find every Row-Bot settings page: six groups from General to System, with search for any setting.
- [Settings: Providers](/docs/settings/providers)
  Route: /docs/settings/providers. Connect local, hosted, subscription, and custom model providers.
- [Settings: Models](/docs/settings/models)
  Route: /docs/settings/models. Choose which model does each job (Brain, Vision, Image, Video), set the reading limit and limits for long work, and pin models from the catalog.
- [Settings: Memory](/docs/settings/knowledge)
  Route: /docs/settings/knowledge. Turn remembering on or off, check graph health, configure the wiki vault, and delete all knowledge in Settings Memory.
- [Settings: Buddy](/docs/settings/buddy)
  Route: /docs/settings/buddy. Use Buddy in the sidebar or as a compact desktop overlay, message the selected thread, handle approvals, and configure its appearance.
- [Settings: Voice](/docs/settings/voice)
  Route: /docs/settings/voice. Configure dictation, realtime talk, read-aloud, voice models, devices, and diagnostics.
- [Settings: System](/docs/settings/system)
  Route: /docs/settings/system. Choose Row-Bot's workspace folder and what it may do on this computer (commands, files, browser and computer use), and manage logs.
- [Settings: Tracker](/docs/settings/tracker)
  Route: /docs/settings/tracker. Configure recurring activity, habit, symptom, and health tracking surfaces.
- [Settings: Documents](/docs/settings/documents)
  Route: /docs/settings/documents. Manage document ingestion, extraction, and vector indexing.
- [Settings: Tools](/docs/settings/tools)
  Route: /docs/settings/tools. Configure progressive external-tool loading, retrieval compression, search and knowledge tools, built-in tools, and custom tools.
- [Settings: Skills](/docs/settings/skills)
  Route: /docs/settings/skills. Find, add, try, update, and remove skills, and open the skill editor to create or edit one.
- [Settings: Apps](/docs/settings/apps)
  Route: /docs/settings/apps. Find and connect the services Row-Bot can work in, including your accounts and messaging channels, choose what each app may do, change its settings, and turn apps off or remove them.
- [Settings: Preferences](/docs/settings/preferences)
  Route: /docs/settings/preferences. Set the assistant's name and personality, learning new skills, how Row-Bot opens, the overnight Dream Cycle, and this device's appearance.
- [Extend Row-Bot](/docs/extending/)
  Route: /docs/extending/. Choose between built-in tools, Skills, Custom Tools, packages, apps, channels, and accounts, and how Row-Bot sets apps and skills up.
- [Accounts And Authorisation](/docs/integrations/accounts)
  Route: /docs/integrations/accounts. Connect your GitHub, Google and X accounts as apps, set Google up with your own OAuth client, and keep scopes, tokens and data flow understandable.
- [Channels](/docs/integrations/channels)
  Route: /docs/integrations/channels. Connect Row-Bot to messaging channels as apps: setup steps, pairing, public addresses, delivery, and safe external behavior.
- [Skills](/docs/skills/)
  Route: /docs/skills/. Find, add, use, turn off, remove, create and troubleshoot Row-Bot skills, and how Row-Bot picks them automatically.
- [Packages (Plugins)](/docs/integrations/plugins)
  Route: /docs/integrations/plugins. Add, turn off, and remove packages of apps and skills in Settings Apps.
- [Hosted And Local Apps (MCP)](/docs/integrations/mcp)
  Route: /docs/integrations/mcp. How apps that are hosted or run on this computer connect, which of their actions ask first, Windows connectors, the Composio broker, and turning apps off or removing them.
- [Voice And Buddy](/docs/voice-and-buddy/)
  Route: /docs/voice-and-buddy/. Configure Dictate, Talk, local voice, realtime voice, read-aloud, devices, and Buddy.
- [Catalog Source Adapters](/docs/extending/source-adapters)
  Route: /docs/extending/source-adapters. For developers: the source adapter interface in src/row_bot/integrations/sources.py, how a new catalog source is added as one adapter plus data, and the passive-read rules every source follows.
- [Contribute To The App Catalog](/docs/extending/app-catalog)
  Route: /docs/extending/app-catalog. For developers: the apps.json record format, verified-vendor rules, bundled icons and their licences, the featured skills and broker lists, and how to check catalog coverage.
- [MCP Bundles (.mcpb)](/docs/extending/mcp-bundles)
  Route: /docs/extending/mcp-bundles. For developers: how Row-Bot imports .mcpb bundles, which manifest fields it reads, how user_config becomes setup inputs, platform and runtime checks, signatures, and Registry bundles downloaded only after consent and a checksum match.
- [Sign-In And Client Metadata](/docs/extending/sign-in-and-client-metadata)
  Route: /docs/extending/sign-in-and-client-metadata. For developers: how Row-Bot signs in to a hosted app, using its published OAuth client metadata document (CIMD), dynamic client registration or the person's own OAuth app, with a loopback redirect.
- [Hosting MCP Apps Views](/docs/extending/mcp-apps)
  Route: /docs/extending/mcp-apps. For developers: how Row-Bot shows an app's ui:// view in chat, with the sandboxed frame, its Content-Security-Policy, declared domains, the bridge messages it answers, limits, and calls that go through approvals.
- [Operations, Data, And Recovery](/docs/operations/)
  Route: /docs/operations/. Back up, restore, update, repair, and uninstall Row-Bot without losing track of local data and credentials.
- [Remote Access And Server Mode](/docs/operations/remote-access)
  Route: /docs/operations/remote-access. Use Row-Bot as one owner from trusted devices through Tailscale, LAN, SSH, Docker, or an HTTPS reverse proxy.
- [Docker And VPS Operations](/docs/operations/docker)
  Route: /docs/operations/docker. Run one persistent Row-Bot server with Docker Compose, private host access, or an operator-managed HTTPS edge.
- [Privacy And Safety](/docs/privacy-safety/)
  Route: /docs/privacy-safety/. Understand local data, provider calls, credentials, approvals, channels, MCP, plugins, and sharing.
- [Troubleshooting](/docs/troubleshooting/)
  Route: /docs/troubleshooting/. Resolve setup, model, chat, approval, workflow, design, code folder, Knowledge, Monitor, app, skill, channel, account, catalog, voice, and Buddy issues.
- [Reference](/docs/reference/)
  Route: /docs/reference/. Look up Row-Bot tools, providers, settings, channels, skills, MCP, plugins, data storage, and approvals.
- [Tools](/docs/reference/generated/tools)
  Route: /docs/reference/generated/tools. Generated reference for Row-Bot tools and tool guides.

  Route: /docs/reference/generated/providers. Generated reference for model providers and provider risk labels.

  Route: /docs/reference/generated/settings-controls. Generated reference for every searchable setting, with deep links, search keywords, dependency notes, and security notes.

  Route: /docs/home/developer. Home no longer has a Developer tab; code folders open in a conversation's Developer panel.
- [Home](/docs/home/)
  Route: /docs/home/. Home's five tabs: Overview, Workflows, Knowledge, Monitor and Insights.
- [Home: Knowledge](/docs/home/knowledge)
  Route: /docs/home/knowledge. Use Home Knowledge to explore the memory graph, search and review memories, and run Dream Cycle.
- [Home: Monitor](/docs/home/monitor)
  Route: /docs/home/monitor. Use Home Monitor to see Row-Bot's latest health checks, fix problems in one click, and read activity, history and logs.
- [Home: Workflows](/docs/home/workflows)
  Route: /docs/home/workflows. Use Home Workflows to run saved workflows in one click, create or edit them on the page, and set delivery defaults.

  Route: /docs/reference/generated/. Compact lookup tables for Row-Bot features and settings.
- [Settings: Accounts](/docs/settings/accounts)
  Route: /docs/settings/accounts. Settings no longer has an Accounts page; the GitHub, Google and X accounts are apps in Settings Apps.
- [Settings: Channels](/docs/settings/channels)
  Route: /docs/settings/channels. Settings no longer has a Channels page; Telegram, WhatsApp, Discord, Slack and SMS are apps in Settings Apps.
- [Settings: Integrations](/docs/settings/integrations)
  Route: /docs/settings/integrations. Settings no longer has an Integrations page; apps are in Settings Apps and skills are in Settings Skills.
- [Settings: MCP](/docs/settings/mcp)
  Route: /docs/settings/mcp. Settings no longer has an MCP page; connections are apps in Settings Apps.
- [Settings: Plugins](/docs/settings/plugins)
  Route: /docs/settings/plugins. Settings no longer has a Plugins page; packages are in Settings Apps.
- [Settings: Utilities](/docs/settings/utilities)
  Route: /docs/settings/utilities. Settings no longer has a Utilities page; the built-in tools are part of Settings Tools.

  Route: /docs/ui-tour/. A short guided tour of Row-Bot: the sidebar, Home, a conversation, panels, the command palette and Settings.
